analysis:
Both supplied units are base-text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 870-1249 and 1249 onward). The file is documentation only, with no code, config or protocol behavior in these units. The excerpts contain only unchanged base text, so I could not see the actual patch diff and cannot confirm which lines changed. Because no head-side change is visible, I cannot cite a head line.

The changelog describes security-relevant features, and the canonical threat model already covers them. These include SSD prefix cache encryption (T-041), prefix-cache scope restrictions, cache routing evidence, profiler tables (T-051), and the system-history and media-handling changes. One thing for later passes: the changelog states a raised default SSD cache ceiling of 100 GiB, limited to half of the available space. The T-041 model describes available-disk/2 with no fixed ceiling, so the threat model and the changelog may differ. That is a documentation observation, not evidence of a regression, and I did not verify it against source. If the PR also touches SSDPrefixCachePolicy or PrefixCachePolicy.ssdDiskBudgetBytes, those files need review. This is a coverage limit, not a clearance, since no source or patch files were supplied.
